newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkey sells 100,000 T barley to Glencore, Toepfer.
newsitem.headline: Turkey sells 100,000 T barley to Glencore, Toepfer.

text.p: Turkey's state grain board (TMO) said on Wednesday it awarded its 100,000-tonne feed barley tender equally to Glencore at $142.29 per tonne and to Alfred Toepfer at $142.12 per tonne with both shipments in May, grain officials said.
"We had much better prices this time than the initial offer in February, which we cancelled due to bad bid prices," the official said.
Alfred Toepfer's shipment will be from Mersin on May 12-23 and that of Glencore's from Mersin or Derince on May 12-23 or May 15-30, according to the companies' bidding terms.
"The recent Saudi tender and the EU's not giving subsidies last week has boosted prices on markets. I think the timing of the tender was just excellent," the official said.
The TMO sold the barley from its stocks of about 300,000 tonnes. It still retains about 150,000 tonnes for emergency use.
Five other international companies -- Cargill, Finagrain, Louis Dreyfus, Lacosp and Grain & Fourrages -- participated in the tender.

Asked about possible disruption of exports from Mersin from May 6 because of a dispute over port service prices, the official said, "Such a situation may affect us as well. But we have to look into the issue."
